description: Realtime updates, presence (who's online), typing indicators and approvals for your Bubble app, on Hibira's hosted Pusher-compatible WebSockets. Drop a Hibira Channel element on a page, publish events from any workflow, and react to them instantly: live dashboards, chat, order tracking, notifications and collaborative pages. Free plan, no card.
name: Hibira Realtime
plugin_instructions:
Hibira Realtime adds live updates, presence ("who's online") and approvals to your Bubble app, over Hibira's hosted WebSockets (Pusher-compatible, servers in Asia). Free plan: 100 connections, no card. https://hibira.io

SETUP
1. Create a free account at https://hibira.io and create an app. Copy its App ID, Key and Secret (the secret is shown once).
2. On the app's Settings in the Hibira portal, add your Bubble domains to Allowed origins (for example https://yourapp.bubbleapps.io and your custom domain).
3. In Bubble, open Plugins > Hibira Realtime and fill in App key, App ID and App secret. Leave Host empty (it defaults to ws.hibira.io).

RECEIVE EVENTS
4. Drop a "Hibira Channel" element on the page and set its Channel, such as orders or "order-" & Current page order's unique id.
5. Add a workflow: When Hibira Channel an event is received. Read the element's Last event, Last data (text) and Last value (set Value key, such as status or order.status, to pull one value out of JSON data).

SEND EVENTS
6. In any workflow (front end or back end), add "Hibira - Publish event" with Channels, Event and Data (JSON or plain text, or Data fields key/value pairs). Pass a Hibira Channel's Socket ID in "Skip socket ID" so the sender doesn't get its own event.

PRIVATE AND PRESENCE CHANNELS
Channels named private-... or presence-... need your app's permission for each user:
7. Add a workflow: When Hibira Channel authorization is needed.
   Step 1: "Hibira - Authorize channel" with Socket ID = the element's Auth socket ID, Channel = the element's Auth channel, User ID = Current User's unique id, User name = Current User's name. Add an Only when condition to decide who may join.
   Step 2: the element's "Complete authorization" with Auth = Result of step 1's Auth and Channel data = Result of step 1's Channel data.
Presence channels then fill Member count, Member IDs, Member names, My ID, and fire "a member joins" / "a member leaves" (Changed member ID / name).
On private and presence channels, "Send client event" sends straight from the browser to the others (turn on client events in the Hibira app settings), for typing indicators and cursors.

APPROVALS
"Hibira - Request approval" returns an Approval link to send to a person (and can announce it on a channel or by push). "Hibira - Get approval" returns Status (pending, approved, rejected, expired), Choice and Comment; Wait up to 25 seconds for the answer.

TIPS
- Every Hibira Channel element on a page shares one connection, so one visitor counts as one connection.
- Several events can arrive faster than a workflow runs; use Event count or keep the event's data in one JSON event.
- Errors show in the element's Error state and fire "an error occurs". Server actions return Success / Error message instead of stopping your workflow.

Docs and source: https://github.com/hibira-io/bubble
